title: UneceMarking
description: An inscription, stamp or label on packaging, such as to indicate date, ownership, quality, manufacture or origin.

automaticDataCaptureMethodTypeCode.description: A code specifying an automatic data capture method type for this packaging marking.

content.description: Content, expressed as text, of this packaging marking.

contentAmount.description: Content, expressed as a monetary amount, for this packaging marking.

contentCode.description: Content, expressed as a code, of this packaging marking.

contentDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the content of this packaging marking.

packagingMarkingBarcodeTypeCode.description: A code specifying a type of barcode for this packaging marking.

packagingMarkingTypeCode.description: A code specifying a type of packaging marking.

specifiedLogisticsLabel.description: A logistics label specified for this packaging marking.
